sloka: पुत्रैः अनुगतः श्रीमान् श्रीमद्भिः च महायशाः ।प्रविवेश गृहम् राजा हिमवत् सदृशम् प्रियम् ॥१-७७-९॥
transliteration: putraiḥ anugataḥ śrīmān śrīmadbhiḥ ca mahāyaśāḥ ।praviveśa gṛham rājā himavat sadṛśam priyam ॥1-77-9॥

translations.english: Prosperous king Dasaratha of great fame followed by his elegant sons entered the city of Ayodhya while the citizens and brahmins came forward from a long distance to welcome him who reentered his palace looking like the Himalayan mountain.
